transcript: Speaker A: 18 saal mein shaadi, 23 saal mein vidhwa... [Married at 18, widowed at 23. Five daughters, no education, no English. Rejected by family and jobs. She downloaded 'English Seekho' for a 1-rupee trial, practiced daily with the AI coach, and got a job. Now she earns 34,000 monthly and supports her daughters. Download the app to learn English.]
summary: An animated narrative of a widowed mother who overcomes financial struggles and job rejection by learning English on the 'English Seekho' app. She uses the AI coach to practice, gets hired, and achieves independence. The call to action promotes a 1-rupee trial of the app.
